# Fonts bundled with GodotLuau

GodotLuau draws Roblox `FontFace` / `Enum.Font` text with these free fonts,
all taken from the Google Fonts repository (https://github.com/google/fonts).
Each font keeps its own license, included in this folder next to this file.
No font made by Roblox or licensed to Roblox is included.

| Roblox family | Font used here | License | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| GothamSSm (Gotham) | Montserrat (closest free match) | OFL 1.1 | montserrat-vf.woff2 |
| LegacyArial, Arial, Arimo | Arimo (metric-compatible with Arial) | OFL 1.1 | arimo-vf.woff2 |
| SourceSansPro | Source Sans 3 | OFL 1.1 (RFN "Source") | sourcesans3-vf.ttf |
| PressStart2P | Press Start 2P | OFL 1.1 (RFN) | pressstart2p-regular.ttf |
| Inconsolata | Inconsolata | OFL 1.1 | inconsolata-vf.woff2 |
| FredokaOne | Fredoka (weight 600) | OFL 1.1 | fredoka-vf.woff2 |
| LuckiestGuy | Luckiest Guy | Apache 2.0 | luckiestguy-regular.ttf |
| Bangers | Bangers | OFL 1.1 | bangers-regular.woff2 |
| Roboto, BuilderSans | Roboto | OFL 1.1 | roboto-vf.woff2 |

Fonts with a Reserved Font Name (RFN), the Apache 2.0 ones and Ubuntu are
shipped **unmodified** (the original file from Google Fonts). The rest are
subset to Latin, Latin Extended, Greek, Cyrillic, Vietnamese and common
symbols, and stored as WOFF2; the OFL allows this for fonts without a
Reserved Font Name. Text in other scripts falls back to the system fonts.
